title: Change freeze
text: Production change freeze 4-9 Nov. No deploys.

title: Deploy freeze for the payments service
text: Hi all, a reminder that the payments service is frozen from 4 November until 9 November 2026 for the audit. Please hold any deploy or migration until then; hotfixes need sign-off from Priya.

title: Travel policy
text: Any travel over £500 needs pre-approval from finance.

title: Policy update: international travel
text:
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:00

Team,

Following the board meeting, all international travel is paused with immediate effect until 31 January 2027. Domestic trips are unaffected. Exceptions need written approval from Dana Whitfield.

Thanks
